system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Upgraded to premium via family plan. Clicked to invite family members and entered info. Realized after it was asking me to confirm MY details with no way to change it in my profile. Support can't change it. you should totally change this, not good.

PREDICTED INTENT: family_plan

PRECEDENTS:

[2709268] (similarity 0.73, intent family_plan)
  past customer: I paid for a premium family plan, all the other accounts are working but my account does not receive the premium features. My account username is sarimr_12. Please help with this issue.
  spotify replied: Hey Sarim! We can confirm that "sarimr_12" is part of a Premium for Family plan. Can you send us a screenshot of your account profile as it appears on the app showing your username? Just go to Your Library and tap on the upper left corner icon. We'll take a closer look

[1990572] (similarity 0.71, intent family_plan)
  past customer: Although I bought family premium just a minute ago, still there is no change in the type of account.
  spotify replied: Hey there! That's not cool. Does logging out > restarting the device > logging back in help? Keep us posted

[1782719] (similarity 0.70, intent family_plan)
  past customer: just signed up for premium family plan my daughter cannot accept invite. We are both being treated as the plan admin.
  spotify replied: Hey there! The cavalry's here. Could you fire over your daughter's email address or username, as well as yours? We'll check backstage

[1019571] (similarity 0.70, intent family_plan)
  past customer: I upgraded from premium to family account (this morning) but cannot invite members as the activation screens is white
  spotify replied: Hi, help's here! Could you give it another go using an incognito window? We'd also suggest trying it out on a desktop. Any better?

[962771] (similarity 0.69, intent family_plan)
  past customer: everytime I try and add a member to my premium family this is what I see. Help pls <link>
  spotify replied: Hi! We'd suggest trying again using a different browser or a private browsing window. Let us know how it goes

Draft the reply as JSON.
text: {"reply":"Hey there! We'd suggest trying the invite flow using a different browser or a private browsing window, preferably on a desktop. Let us know how it goes","confidence":0.66,"evidence_ids":["1019571","962771"]}
